2020_166_sep_2020_pcard_report.paragraph: A 16-page procurement-card transaction listing for the Troy School District covering September 2020 activity, printed 11/12/2020 and carried on the Board of Education agenda of November 17, 2020. Each row records a transaction description (posting date plus merchant), a journal entry label of either SEP PCARD EXPENSE or SEP US BANK PCARD, a budget unit, an account code, and either a transaction amount or a credit. The listing subtotals $137,789.55 in charges against $5,418.75 in credits, with Total Expenses stated as $132,370.80. The largest single charge is $9,178.09 to ZOOM.US on 8/31/2020, coded to budget unit 101790225000000, account 3450.

2020_166_sep_2020_pcard_report.verbose:
TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD REPORT, SEP 2020 is a sixteen-page procurement-card transaction register, each page footed with the print date 11/12/2020, included in the Troy School District Board of Education materials for the meeting of November 17, 2020. The register is laid out in six columns: Transaction Description, JE Number, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, and Credits. Transaction descriptions concatenate a posting date with a truncated merchant identifier as it arrives from the card processor, for example "8/31/2020-STAPLS731276", "9/11/2020-B&H PHOTO 80", or "9/25/2020-AMZN MKTP US". Posting dates span 8/28/2020 through 9/25/2020. Two journal entry labels are used: SEP PCARD EXPENSE for the first block of transactions and SEP US BANK PCARD for the second, indicating two card programs consolidated into one report.

Totals. The register closes with a Subtotal line of 137,789.55 in the Transaction Amount column and 5,418.75 in the Credits column, followed by Total Expenses of 132,370.80.

Largest charges. The single largest line is 9,178.09 to ZOOM.US 888- dated 8/31/2020, budget unit 101790225000000, account 3450; a second Zoom charge of 410.33 appears on 9/4/2020 to the same budget unit and account under the US Bank card, and a Zoom charge of 68.89 on 9/21/2020 to 101010111100100, account 5110. Next largest is AMZN MKTP US at 6,866.52 on 8/31/2020, budget unit 700015199703900, account 5000. GREAT LAKES on 9/10/2020 is 5,857.34 in 101902261860300, account 5990. Two LAKE STATE C charges of 3,890.00 each appear on 9/18/2020 in 101970293000000, account 6410. CAMBRIDGE UN on 9/8/2020 is 2,884.53 in 101074113007400, account 5210, in the same budget unit as AMAZON.COM M charges of 900.00 on 9/3/2020 and 1,020.00 on 9/7/2020 (also account 5210) and a JUNIOR LIBRA charge of 2,419.40 on 9/25/2020, account 5110.
